How to apply EI in Canada

Answer:

To apply for Employment Insurance (EI) in Canada, you need to follow these steps:

1. Check eligibility: To be eligible for EI, you must have worked in the past 52 weeks (or 40 weeks if you are self-employed) and have earned at least 600 hours of insurable employment.

2. Register for EI: You can register for EI online through the Service Canada website or by calling the EI service center in your province or territory.

3. Complete the application: Fill out the EI application form, providing details about your employment history, income, and reasons for applying for EI.

4. Wait for approval: After submitting your application, you will need to wait for approval from Service Canada. This process can take up to 10 days.

5. Receive your EI benefits: If your application is approved, you will receive your EI benefits through the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) via direct deposit or cheque.

For more information on EI, visit the Service Canada website or contact your local EI service center.

Source: https://www.canada.ca/en/services/employment-income-support/employment-insurance.html
